dedupe_keys.name: scalable filterless coherent point to multipoint metro network architecture

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The completed planning study uses real Telecom Italia Mobile metro-aggregation networks to compare traditional P2P coherent modules with digital-subcarrier P2P/P2MP designs. Coverage comprises a three-phase deployment analysis combining network design and techno-economics. The source attributes cost savings to flexible DSC-based modules. Companion urban/rural and long-term traffic analyses retain their scenario roles; they are not counted as new independent operational deployments. Exact network asset files, phase dates and cost data are not supplied in the inspected abstract. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
